versions.line: Claudopus no longer makes macOS show "Keychain Not Found" when it runs in a home folder that has no keychain
Panel buttons answer clicks again with many tasks at work
When you answer in your own words above the chat, or paste a key or give a response there
Every background task, small task and helper now has the tool to ask Claudopus to wake it for a file
A task's card no longer says "2 commands have ended" above commands still working
A run one task leaves going is shown on the card of the task whose command started it
No task or helper can start a command whose only job is to wait, whatever shape it takes
Tasks, checks and helpers now start with only the tools their work takes
A command's line no longer counts "nothing printed for 10s, 15s…" while it is quiet for a few seconds
The battery card shows what the whole Mac really draws on battery, from the battery's own voltage and current
A box asking for a key has no field of its own in the panel any more
When a task's own command ends (finished, failed or stopped), Claudopus wakes the task at once
Plainer words everywhere
If a task stops partway through a step without a report (because the app restarted
Every command on a card now has a short plain line under it
The instructions Claudopus gives chats and tasks are about a third shorter, and each rule is said once
A button in the panel, such as What's new or Close in the update note, now works on the first click
The README, the guide, the privacy page and claudopus.ai now describe Claudopus as it is today
Stats no longer fails with "Svg source longer than 131072 characters" once there is a lot of history
Your reply now reaches a task right away, even while it runs something long
In the desktop app, a card's answers now end with "Reply in your own words"
Everything Claudopus says about updating now says only three things
claudopus.ai is now built only from main, not from every branch pushed
The Keys button beside Memory is gone
Typing in a reply box no longer pulls the panel back down
When you press Allow once, Always allow, Deny or a question's buttons, the answer shows right away
After Update (or Install) there is no Reload button
In the desktop app, a figure's card above the prompt now floats over the chat, just above its figure
A chat that runs Claudopus's own code now updates with one press of Update, then Reload
A task that finishes now comes to the top of the panel right away, just under anything that waits for you
